set.smtpGmailHint: Gmail waxa uu u baahan yahay Password App, ee maaha eraygaaga sirta ah ee caadiga ah.
set.smtpGmailStep1: Guji Isticmaal Gmail-ka hoose - martigeliyaha, dekedda 587, iyo TLS si toos ah u buuxi.
set.smtpGmailStep2: Geli Gmail kaaga oo buuxa imaylka iyo magaca isticmaale (tusaale you@gmail.com).
set.smtpGmailStep3: Daar Xaqiijinta 2-tilaabo ee Koontadaada Google, ka dibna samee Password App ah. Isticmaal erayga sirta ah halkan-ma aha eraygaaga Gmail ee caadiga ah.
set.smtpGmailStep4: Ku dheji erayga sirta ah ee App-ka gudaha goobta sirta ah.
set.smtpGmailStep5: Guji Save xagga sare ee boggan.
set.smtpMissingBody: Deji SMTP ka hor intaadan isticmaalin Dir Email. SMTP la'aanteed, iimaylada dukumeentiga ah lagama soo diri karo abka.
set.smtpPasswordKeep: Banaan ku dhaaf si aad u sii jirto
set.smtpReadyBody: Iimayl dhokumenti ah ayaa soo diri doona server-kan marka aad isticmaasho iimaylka dir. Daar lifaaqa PDF ee qaab-dhismeedka iimaylka.
set.smtpWebStep1: Guji Isticmaal Webmail hoose - Hostinger defaults si toos ah u buuxi (smtp.hostinger.com, dekedda 465, SSL). Beddel martigeliyaha haddii aad adeegsato bixiye kale.
set.smtpWebStep2: Hostinger: ku hayso dekedda 465 oo leh TLS off (SSL). Bixiyeyaasha kale, dekedda 587 + Isticmaal TLS waa wax caadi ah.
set.smtpWebStep3: Ku buuxi emailka, Magaca, isticmaalaha (email buuxa), iyo erayga sirta ah ee sanduuqa boostada.
set.smtpWebStep4: Guji Save xagga sare ee boggan, ka dib u soo dir dukumeenti tijaabo ah iimaylka.
set.smtpWebmailHint: Hostinger tusaale ahaan: smtp.hostinger.com · dekedda 465 · SSL
